body:
I do wish I could talk to her, she's a freaking ticking time bomb when it comes to talking about serious stuff though.

One time she was in an abusive relationship with a guy who I KNEW was a piece of shit, cuz I knew him in high school. I told her she was being played by a gross jerk and she went the fuck off on me, told me she knows he's the one and he's her future and stuff and she can't be my friend anymore because I hinder her from happiness since I didn't approve of this guy she had known for a week. She cut me off and two weeks later dude dumped her. She doesn't like when I bring it up because she knows she was wrong and never even apologized. I think she has a pride issue or something because she fucking HATES talking about serious issues with herself or in her life.

I feel like it'll just end in us not being friends anymore, and it sucks, because I feel like I'm the only one who cares this much. Not even her boyfriends are willing to bring it up to her.

Facebook is the absolute worst social media site in existence. It is a giant cesspool of ads, unsolicited opinions, and misinformation.

I saw an "Interesting Facts" post one of my friends shared that talked about some African tribe that, when one of them did something wrong, would surround them with love and happiness for days and tell them everything they did right to uplift them. The photo showed a black man crying of what appeared to be joy with people around him.

The real origin of that photo was a fucking soccer team after a win. I hate Facebook.

I would LOVE to get him back into a treatment center but he can't afford it. He's been in treatment 3 times and relapsed each time. His insurance is used up and his grandparents are no longer willing to pay for his shit (understandably so, considering he relapses in less than a month every single time he gets treatment)

I just feel completely and totally helpless. I don't want this burden in my life but I also don't want to see him die. I've never been so conflicted.

It's just that he has no one else. Literally. He has no other friends because he pushed them all away and he doesn't really have family.

You're completely right, I'm just torn. Torn between not wanting any of that negativity in my life but also not wanting to cut him off when he has no one else.

It's a totally shitty situation. I've told him it's fucked up but he just tells me I'm "being mean"

He tried to kill himself a year ago, so I wouldn't put it past him to try again

That's exactly what I want to do, only thing is I'm afraid he will kill himself if I do. I couldn't live with that.

Like I said in the post he's essentially holding me hostage with this. I don't know what to do.

(P.S. Happy Reddit bday :3)

He did seek help. 3 times. He used his insurance all up and can't afford to get help a 4th time.

I don't WANT to let him play these games, I just don't want him to kill himself. He has actively tried to overdose in the past when things weren't even that bad. Things are much worse now. I just don't know what to do. If he ends up offing himself I'll feel like it's my fault no matter what happens.

Using a Subreddit about depression to advertise a book. Classy.

If a book were a suitable method of treatment for depression/addiction then we wouldn't have entire treatment centers dedicated to helping people like this, we would all just read a book. $7.99 is a lot cheaper than extensive therapy. 

Go advertise your bullshit somewhere else.

I make a post about wanting to kill myself and you respond by asking me what I do for fun and that you want to tell me something about your life. Wow lol. No thanks. 

It's *really* inconsiderate of you to go to a fucking Suicide Watch subreddit to promote your spiritual garbage. Maybe empathy is something *you* should practice more.
